Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 1: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 2: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(3, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 3: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 4: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(6, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 5: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(7, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 6: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(8, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 7: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(9, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 8: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(10, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 9: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(13, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 10: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(14, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 11: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(15, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 12: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(17, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 13: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(18, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 14: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(20, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 15: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(33, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 16: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(37, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 17: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(61, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 18: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(92, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 19: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(103, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 20: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(109, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 21: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(139, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 22: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 23: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 24: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 25: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 26: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 27: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 28: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 29: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 30: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 31: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 32: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 33: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(33, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 34: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(33, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 35: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(33, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 36: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(33, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 37: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(7, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 38: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 39: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(61, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 40: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 41: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 42: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 43: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(1, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 44: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(2, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 45: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(3, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 46: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(0, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 47: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(4, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 48: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(-2, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 49: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(1, 110, 50, 10, 10)
    Case 50: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(1, 110, 10, 10, 50)
    Case 51: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(2, 110, 50, 10, 10)
    Case 52: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(3, 110, 10, 10, 50)
    Case 53: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(1, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    Case 54: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(1, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 55: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(2, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 56: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(1, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 57: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 58: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 59: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 60: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(1, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 61: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(2, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 62: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(3, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 63: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddConnector(1, 10, 10, 110, 50)
    End Select
    Select Case which
    Case 22
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.25
    Case 23
        sh.Adjustments.Item(1) = 0.3
    Case 24
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0
    Case 25
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.5
    Case 26
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 2
    Case 27
        sh.Adjustments(1) = -1
    Case 28
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.123456
    Case 29
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.16667
    Case 30
        sh.Adjustments(2) = 0.3
    Case 31
        sh.Adjustments(0) = 0.3
    Case 32
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 33
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 34
        sh.Adjustments(2) = 0.3
    Case 35
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.3: sh.Adjustments(2) = 0.7
    Case 36
        sh.Adjustments(2) = 0.7: sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 37
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.25
    Case 38
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.25
    Case 39
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.25
    Case 40
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.25: sh.AutoShapeType = 1
    Case 41
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.25: sh.AutoShapeType = 33
    Case 42
        sh.Width = 200: sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.25
    Case 54
        sh.ConnectorFormat.Type = 2
    Case 55
        sh.ConnectorFormat.Type = 3
    Case 56
        sh.ConnectorFormat.Type = 9
    Case 58
        sh.ConnectorFormat.Type = 2
    Case 59
        sh.ConnectorFormat.Type = 2
    Case 60
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 61
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 62
        sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 63
        sh.Line.EndArrowheadStyle = 2
    End Select
    s = "ok"
Measured:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.AutoShapeType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Connector
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Left
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Top
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Width
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Height
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.HorizontalFlip
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.VerticalFlip
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.Adjustments)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments(1)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments.Item(1)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments(2)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments(3)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments(4)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.ConnectorFormat)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.ConnectorFormat.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.ConnectorFormat.BeginConnected
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.ConnectorFormat.EndConnected
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.Weight
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Measured
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 63
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
